title: TOTALYTD gives the same value as CALCULATE with DATESYTD
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "TotalYtd", TOTALYTD ( [Sales], 'Date'[Date] ), "Calculate", CALCULATE ( [Sales], DATESYTD ( 'Date'[Date] ) ) ), 'Date'[Date] = DATE ( 2024, 5, 20 ) )

source.quote: TOTALYTD is just syntax sugar for CALCULATE / DATESYTD
source.supports: the example shows the two forms returning the same value

derivation: Year to date at 2024-05-20: Jan 300 + Feb 700 + Mar 500 + May 20 600 = 2100, in both forms. [Sales] is the SUM of a fixed decimal column, so the type is decimal.
